title: Farm Flapper
oneLiner: Flap, shoot eggs, scare farm pests, deliver to the farmer, beat the board.
inspiredBy: Light arcade shoot-and-collect (eggs, mounts, basket multiplier)
targetAudience: Casual Facebook / Messenger players 13–44 who want a 1–3 minute arcade burst, not a word puzzle.

pillars.coreLoop: Flap → shoot pests / grab coins → survive pipes → tally → share or retry
pillars.social: Challenge Friends via shareAsync; optional Instant Games + web leaderboard
pillars.retention: Personal best, named board, mounts/clovers/lives keep runs spicy
pillars.monetization: None in imported v1. Optional rewarded continue later — never mid-flap
pillars.discovery: Duck + egg on navy farm sky; cover shows flap past hay
pillars.liveOps: Seasonal farm skins, weekend 2× basket, limited pest events
